=INSERT INTO kaspi_fx_rates (day, cbr_date, kzt_rub, vnd_rub)
VALUES ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date,
        '{{ String($json.Date).slice(0, 10) }}',
        {{ $json.Valute.KZT.Value / $json.Valute.KZT.Nominal }},
        {{ $json.Valute.VND ? $json.Valute.VND.Value / $json.Valute.VND.Nominal : 'NULL' }})
ON CONFLICT (day) DO UPDATE SET cbr_date = EXCLUDED.cbr_date, kzt_rub = EXCLUDED.kzt_rub,
       vnd_rub = EXCLUDED.vnd_rub, fetched_at = now()
RETURNING day;

=WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ $('Parse').first().json.sql_json }}'::jsonb) AS x(
    card text, op_date date, kind text, operation text, merchant text, merchant_norm text,
    amount_kzt numeric, orig_amount numeric, orig_currency text, occ smallint, dedup_key text, pos int)
), card AS (
  -- подпись карты при первой выписке: имя того, кто прислал (дальше правится только руками в БД)
  INSERT INTO kaspi_cards (card, label)
  SELECT '{{ $('Parse').first().json.sql_card }}', '{{ $('Parse').first().json.sql_card_label }}'
   WHERE '{{ $('Parse').first().json.sql_card }}' <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (card) DO NOTHING
), rate AS (
  -- самый свежий курс: сегодняшний, а если ЦБ не ответил — последний известный
  SELECT * FROM kaspi_fx_rates ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO kaspi_expenses (card, op_date, kind, operation, merchant, merchant_norm, amount_kzt,
       orig_amount, orig_currency, amount_rub, rate_day, kzt_rub, occ, dedup_key, stmt_pos)
SELECT NULLIF(i.card, ''), i.op_date, i.kind, i.operation, i.merchant, i.merchant_norm, i.amount_kzt,
       i.orig_amount, i.orig_currency, round(i.amount_kzt * r.kzt_rub, 2), r.day, r.kzt_rub,
       i.occ, i.dedup_key, i.pos
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON true
-- уже записанные строки: только позиция из свежей выписки (порядок в Mini App), остальное не трогаем
ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO UPDATE SET stmt_pos = EXCLUDED.stmt_pos
RETURNING id, card, op_date, kind, merchant, amount_kzt, orig_amount, orig_currency, amount_rub, stmt_pos,
          (xmax = 0) AS inserted;   -- true — новая строка, false — была и раньше

=-- Продавцы (ключ до «*»), которых нужно разобрать GPT:
--   need_cat — категории нет или она из словаря (source = rule): GPT решает лучше, ручную не трогаем;
--   need_ru  — перевод и сеть ещё не спрашивали (name_ru_at / brand IS NULL).
-- Уже разобранных повторно не шлём. known_brands — уже известные сети, чтобы GPT писал их одинаково.
SELECT kaspi_merchant_key(e.merchant, e.merchant_norm) AS merchant_norm, min(e.merchant) AS merchant,
       bool_or(r.category IS NULL OR r.source = 'rule') AS need_cat,
       bool_or(r.name_ru_at IS NULL OR r.brand IS NULL) AS need_ru,
       (SELECT string_agg(b, ' | ') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT brand AS b FROM kaspi_merchant_rules
                                           WHERE brand <> '' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200) kb) AS known_brands
  FROM kaspi_expenses e
  LEFT JOIN kaspi_merchant_rules r ON r.merchant_norm = kaspi_merchant_key(e.merchant, e.merchant_norm)
 WHERE (r.merchant_norm IS NULL OR r.category IS NULL OR r.source = 'rule'
        OR r.name_ru_at IS NULL OR r.brand IS NULL)
   AND e.kind IN ('purchase', 'fx_diff')
 GROUP BY 1
 LIMIT 150;

=INSERT INTO kaspi_merchant_rules (merchant_norm, category, source, name_ru, name_ru_at, brand)
SELECT merchant_norm, category, COALESCE(source, 'llm'), NULLIF(name_ru, ''),
       CASE WHEN translated THEN now() END, CASE WHEN translated THEN brand END
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ $json.sql_json }}'::jsonb)
       AS x(merchant_norm text, category text, source text, name_ru text, brand text, translated boolean)
-- Категория: пустую заполняем чем есть; словарную (source = rule) GPT перебивает; ручную не трогаем.
-- Перевод и сеть пишем один раз: name_ru_at / brand ('' = сети нет) — отметка «уже спрашивали».
ON CONFLICT (merchant_norm) DO UPDATE SET
       category   = CASE WHEN kaspi_merchant_rules.category IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.category
                         WHEN kaspi_merchant_rules.source = 'rule' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.category IS NOT NULL
                           THEN EXCLUDED.category
                         ELSE kaspi_merchant_rules.category END,
       source     = CASE WHEN kaspi_merchant_rules.source = 'manual' THEN 'manual'
                         WHEN EXCLUDED.category IS NOT NULL AND (kaspi_merchant_rules.category IS NULL
                              OR (kaspi_merchant_rules.source = 'rule' AND EXCLUDED.source = 'llm'))
                           THEN EXCLUDED.source
                         ELSE kaspi_merchant_rules.source END,
       name_ru    = CASE WHEN kaspi_merchant_rules.name_ru_at IS NULL AND EXCLUDED.name_ru_at IS NOT NULL
                         THEN EXCLUDED.name_ru ELSE kaspi_merchant_rules.name_ru END,
       name_ru_at = COALESCE(kaspi_merchant_rules.name_ru_at, EXCLUDED.name_ru_at),
       brand      = COALESCE(kaspi_merchant_rules.brand, EXCLUDED.brand),
       updated_at = now()
RETURNING merchant_norm;
